media.title: Alfredo Bracchi — portrait photograph
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the lyricist Alfredo Bracchi, smiling, in a pinstripe suit.
media.publicCaption: Alfredo Bracchi, Italian lyricist and screenwriter. Bracchi wrote the Italian words of “You’re All I Need”, published as “Tu sei l’amor” (1935).
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer and date unidentified; Wikimedia Commons, public domain.
media.rightsNote: Wikimedia Commons tags the photograph PD-Italia and PD-1996, on the ground that a simple photograph made in Italy before 1976 was out of copyright by 1996. The file names only the film website Mubi as its source; the photographer, the date and the original publication are not known, so the tagging cannot be checked against the photograph’s origin.
